import 'react-native-url-polyfill/auto';

import { DarkTheme, DefaultTheme, Stack, ThemeProvider } from 'expo-router';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { GestureHandlerRootView } from 'react-native-gesture-handler';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { usePerformance } from '@/hooks/use-performance';
import { AuthProvider } from '@/providers/auth-provider';
import { ProfileProvider } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import { SettingsProvider } from '@/providers/settings-provider';

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <GestureHandlerRootView style={{ flex: 1 }}>
      <SafeAreaProvider>
        <AuthProvider>
          <SettingsProvider>
            <ProfileProvider>
              <RootNavigator />
            </ProfileProvider>
          </SettingsProvider>
        </AuthProvider>
      </SafeAreaProvider>
    </GestureHandlerRootView>
  );
}

function RootNavigator() {
  const { colors, isDark } = useAppTheme();
  const { animationsEnabled } = usePerformance();
  const base = isDark ? DarkTheme : DefaultTheme;
  const navigationTheme = {
    ...base,
    colors: {
      ...base.colors,
      primary: colors.primary,
      background: colors.background,
      card: colors.surface,
      text: colors.text,
      border: colors.border,
      notification: colors.primary,
    },
  };

  return (
    <ThemeProvider value={navigationTheme}>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />
      <Stack
        screenOptions={{
          headerShown: false,
          animation: animationsEnabled ? 'slide_from_right' : 'none',
          contentStyle: { backgroundColor: colors.background },
        }}
      >
        <Stack.Screen name="index" />
        <Stack.Screen name="(auth)" />
        <Stack.Screen name="(onboarding)" />
        <Stack.Screen name="(tabs)" />
        <Stack.Screen name="post/[id]" />
        <Stack.Screen name="settings/edit-profile" />
        <Stack.Screen name="settings/connected" />
        <Stack.Screen name="settings/privacy" />
        <Stack.Screen name="settings/privacy-policy" />
        <Stack.Screen name="settings/about" />
        <Stack.Screen name="+not-found" />
      </Stack>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}

import { Text, type TextProps, type TextStyle } from 'react-native';

import { FontSize } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

export type TextVariant =
  | 'display'
  | 'title'
  | 'heading'
  | 'body'
  | 'bodyStrong'
  | 'caption'
  | 'label'
  | 'mono';

interface AppTextProps extends TextProps {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  color?: string;
  align?: TextStyle['textAlign'];
}

const VARIANTS: Record<TextVariant, TextStyle> = {
  display: {
    fontSize: FontSize.display,
    lineHeight: FontSize.display * 1.1,
    fontWeight: '800',
    letterSpacing: -1,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: FontSize.xxl,
    lineHeight: FontSize.xxl * 1.2,
    fontWeight: '800',
    letterSpacing: -0.5,
  },
  heading: {
    fontSize: FontSize.xl,
    lineHeight: FontSize.xl * 1.3,
    fontWeight: '700',
    letterSpacing: -0.3,
  },
  body: {
    fontSize: FontSize.md,
    lineHeight: FontSize.md * 1.45,
    fontWeight: '400',
  },
  bodyStrong: {
    fontSize: FontSize.md,
    lineHeight: FontSize.md * 1.4,
    fontWeight: '600',
  },
  caption: {
    fontSize: FontSize.sm,
    lineHeight: FontSize.sm * 1.4,
    fontWeight: '400',
  },
  label: {
    fontSize: FontSize.xs,
    lineHeight: FontSize.xs * 1.3,
    fontWeight: '700',
    letterSpacing: 0.6,
    textTransform: 'uppercase',
  },
  mono: {
    fontSize: FontSize.sm,
    lineHeight: FontSize.sm * 1.4,
    fontWeight: '500',
    fontFamily: 'monospace',
  },
};

export function AppText({
  variant = 'body',
  color,
  align,
  style,
  children,
  ...rest
}: AppTextProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <Text
      {...rest}
      style={[VARIANTS[variant], { color: color ?? colors.text }, align ? { textAlign: align } : null, style]}
    >
      {children}
    </Text>
  );
}
--- src/components/ui/button.tsx
import type { ComponentProps, ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

type ButtonVariant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'danger';
type ButtonSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

interface ButtonProps {
  label: string;
  onPress?: () => void;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  iconPosition?: 'left' | 'right';
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

const HEIGHTS: Record<ButtonSize, number> = { sm: 38, md: 48, lg: 56 };

export function Button({
  label,
  onPress,
  variant = 'primary',
  size = 'md',
  icon,
  iconPosition = 'left',
  loading = false,
  disabled = false,
  fullWidth = false,
  style,
  accessibilityLabel,
}: ButtonProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const isDisabled = disabled || loading;

  const background: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary: colors.primary,
    secondary: colors.surfaceAlt,
    outline: 'transparent',
    ghost: 'transparent',
    danger: colors.danger,
  };
  const borderColor: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary: colors.primary,
    secondary: colors.surfaceAlt,
    outline: colors.borderStrong,
    ghost: 'transparent',
    danger: colors.danger,
  };
  const textColor: Record<ButtonVariant, string> = {
    primary: colors.onPrimary,
    secondary: colors.text,
    outline: colors.text,
    ghost: colors.textSecondary,
    danger: '#FFFFFF',
  };

  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? label}
      accessibilityState={{ disabled: isDisabled, busy: loading }}
      onPress={isDisabled ? undefined : onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.base,
        {
          height: HEIGHTS[size],
          backgroundColor: background[variant],
          borderColor: borderColor[variant],
          opacity: isDisabled ? 0.5 : pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
        },
        fullWidth && styles.fullWidth,
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <ActivityIndicator color={textColor[variant]} size="small" />
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.content}>
          {icon && iconPosition === 'left' ? (
            <Ionicons name={icon} size={size === 'sm' ? 16 : 19} color={textColor[variant]} />
          ) : null}
          <AppText
            variant="bodyStrong"
            color={textColor[variant]}
            style={size === 'sm' ? styles.smallLabel : undefined}
          >
            {label}
          </AppText>
          {icon && iconPosition === 'right' ? (
            <Ionicons name={icon} size={size === 'sm' ? 16 : 19} color={textColor[variant]} />
          ) : null}
        </View>
      )}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    borderRadius: Radius.pill,
    borderWidth: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
  },
  fullWidth: {
    alignSelf: 'stretch',
  },
  content: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  smallLabel: {
    fontSize: 13,
  },
});

  overlay?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;

export function NetworkBadge({ network, overlay = false, compact = false }: NetworkBadgeProps) {

  const meta = getNetwork(network);
  const background = overlay ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)' : colors.surfaceAlt;

  return (

      {compact ? null : (

--- src/components/ui/text-field.tsx
import { useState, type ComponentProps } from 'react';
import {
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type TextInputProps,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface TextFieldProps extends Omit<TextInputProps, 'style'> {
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  secure?: boolean;
  icon?: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  containerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export function TextField({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  secure = false,
  icon,
  containerStyle,
  multiline,
  ...rest
}: TextFieldProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(secure);

  return (
    <View style={[styles.wrapper, containerStyle]}>
      {label ? (
        <AppText variant="label" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.label}>
          {label}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.inputWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: colors.surface,
            borderColor: error ? colors.danger : focused ? colors.primary : colors.border,
            minHeight: multiline ? 112 : 50,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {icon ? <Ionicons name={icon} size={18} color={colors.textMuted} /> : null}
        <TextInput
          {...rest}
          multiline={multiline}
          secureTextEntry={secure ? hidden : false}
          onFocus={(event) => {
            setFocused(true);
            rest.onFocus?.(event);
          }}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            setFocused(false);
            rest.onBlur?.(event);
          }}
          placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            { color: colors.text },
            multiline ? styles.multiline : null,
          ]}
          accessibilityLabel={label}
        />
        {secure ? (
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={hidden ? 'Mostrar senha' : 'Ocultar senha'}
            onPress={() => setHidden((current) => !current)}
            hitSlop={10}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={hidden ? 'eye-outline' : 'eye-off-outline'}
              size={20}
              color={colors.textSecondary}
            />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {error ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger} style={styles.helper}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : hint ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted} style={styles.helper}>
          {hint}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    gap: Spacing.xs,
  },
  label: {
    marginLeft: Spacing.xs,
  },
  inputWrap: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
    borderWidth: 1,
    borderRadius: Radius.md,
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.md,
    paddingVertical: Spacing.sm,
  },
  input: {
    flex: 1,
    fontSize: 15,
    paddingVertical: 6,
  },
  multiline: {
    textAlignVertical: 'top',
    minHeight: 96,
  },
  helper: {
    marginLeft: Spacing.xs,
  },
});

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, View, type StyleProp, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';

import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface CardProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  onPress?: () => void;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  padded?: boolean;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
}

export function Card({ children, onPress, style, padded = true, accessibilityLabel }: CardProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const cardStyle = [
    styles.card,
    padded && styles.padded,
    { backgroundColor: colors.surface, borderColor: colors.border },
    style,
  ];

  if (onPress) {
    return (
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
        onPress={onPress}
        style={({ pressed }) => [cardStyle, pressed && { opacity: 0.85 }]}
      >
        {children}
      </Pressable>
    );
  }

  return <View style={cardStyle}>{children}</View>;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  card: {
    borderRadius: Radius.lg,
    borderWidth: 1,
    overflow: 'hidden',
  },
  padded: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
  },
});

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface CheckboxProps {
  checked: boolean;
  onChange: (checked: boolean) => void;
  label: ReactNode;
  description?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function Checkbox({ checked, onChange, label, description, error, disabled }: CheckboxProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.wrapper}>
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="checkbox"
        accessibilityState={{ checked, disabled }}
        onPress={disabled ? undefined : () => onChange(!checked)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [styles.row, pressed && { opacity: 0.75 }]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.box,
            {
              backgroundColor: checked ? colors.primary : 'transparent',
              borderColor: error ? colors.danger : checked ? colors.primary : colors.borderStrong,
            },
          ]}
        >
          {checked ? <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={15} color={colors.onPrimary} /> : null}
        </View>
        <View style={styles.texts}>
          <View>{typeof label === 'string' ? <AppText variant="caption">{label}</AppText> : label}</View>
          {description ? (
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted}>
              {description}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </Pressable>
      {error ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger} style={styles.error}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    gap: Spacing.xs,
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'flex-start',

    flex: 1,
    gap: 2,
  },

    marginLeft: 34,
  },
});

interface SettingsRowProps {
  icon?: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  iconColor?: string;
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  right?: ReactNode;
  onPress?: () => void;
  destructive?: boolean;
  last?: boolean;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
}

export function SettingsRow({
  icon,
  iconColor,
  title,
  subtitle,
  right,
  onPress,
  destructive = false,
  last = false,
  accessibilityLabel,
}: SettingsRowProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const content = (
    <>
      {icon ? (
        <View style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
          <Ionicons
            name={icon}
            size={18}
            color={iconColor ?? (destructive ? colors.danger : colors.text)}
          />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.texts}>
        <AppText variant="bodyStrong" color={destructive ? colors.danger : colors.text}>
          {title}
        </AppText>
        {subtitle ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            {subtitle}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {right ?? (onPress ? (
        <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={colors.textMuted} />
      ) : null)}
    </>
  );

  if (!onPress) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.row,
          !last && { borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, borderBottomColor: colors.border },
        ]}
      >
        {content}
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel ?? title}
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.row,
        !last && { borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth, borderBottomColor: colors.border },
        pressed && { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt },
      ]}
    >
      {content}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  group: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  groupTitle: {
    marginLeft: Spacing.xs,
  },
  footer: {
    marginHorizontal: Spacing.xs,
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.md,
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
    paddingVertical: Spacing.md,
    minHeight: 62,
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 36,
    height: 36,
    borderRadius: Radius.sm,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  texts: {
    flex: 1,
    gap: 2,
  },
});
--- src/components/ui/screen.tsx
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import {
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView, type Edge } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { Layout, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface ScreenProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  scroll?: boolean;
  padded?: boolean;
  edges?: Edge[];
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  contentContainerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  keyboardAvoiding?: boolean;
}

export function Screen({
  children,
  scroll = false,
  padded = true,
  edges = ['top'],
  style,
  contentContainerStyle,
  keyboardAvoiding = false,
}: ScreenProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const contentStyle = [
    styles.content,
    padded && styles.padded,
    contentContainerStyle,
  ];

  const body = scroll ? (
    <ScrollView
      style={styles.flex}
      contentContainerStyle={contentStyle}
      keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
      showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
    >
      {children}
    </ScrollView>
  ) : (
    <View style={[styles.flex, contentStyle]}>{children}</View>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.flex, { backgroundColor: colors.background }, style]} edges={edges}>
      {keyboardAvoiding ? (
        <KeyboardAvoidingView
          style={styles.flex}
          behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
        >
          {body}
        </KeyboardAvoidingView>
      ) : (
        body
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  flex: { flex: 1 },
  content: {
    width: '100%',
    maxWidth: Layout.maxContentWidth,
    alignSelf: 'center',
  },
  padded: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: Spacing.xxl,
  },
});

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { StyleSheet, View, type StyleProp, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { useAvatarUri } from '@/hooks/use-avatar-uri';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { usePerformance } from '@/hooks/use-performance';
import { initials } from '@/lib/format';

interface AvatarProps {
  name: string;
  uri?: string | null;
  size?: number;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  ringColor?: string;
}

export function Avatar({ name, uri, size = 44, style, ringColor }: AvatarProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { animationsEnabled, dataSaver } = usePerformance();
  const resolved = useAvatarUri(uri);

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.wrapper,
        {
          width: size,
          height: size,
          borderRadius: size / 2,
          backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt,
          borderColor: ringColor ?? colors.border,
        },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      {resolved ? (
        <Image
          source={{ uri: resolved }}
          style={{ width: size, height: size }}
          contentFit="cover"
          transition={animationsEnabled ? 180 : 0}
          cachePolicy={dataSaver ? 'memory' : 'memory-disk'}
          recyclingKey={uri ?? undefined}
          accessibilityLabel={`Foto de ${name}`}
        />
      ) : (
        <AppText
          variant="bodyStrong"
          color={colors.textSecondary}
          style={{ fontSize: Math.max(12, size * 0.34) }}
        >
          {initials(name)}
        </AppText>
      )}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    overflow: 'hidden',
    borderWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
  },
});

import type { ComponentProps } from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, type StyleProp, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface IconButtonProps {
  name: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  onPress?: () => void;
  size?: number;
  color?: string;
  accessibilityLabel: string;
  variant?: 'plain' | 'surface' | 'overlay';
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function IconButton({
  name,
  onPress,
  size = 22,
  color,
  accessibilityLabel,
  variant = 'plain',
  style,
  disabled = false,
}: IconButtonProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const background =
    variant === 'surface'
      ? colors.surfaceAlt
      : variant === 'overlay'
        ? 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)'
        : 'transparent';
  const iconColor = color ?? (variant === 'overlay' ? '#FFFFFF' : colors.text);

  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
      accessibilityState={{ disabled }}
      onPress={disabled ? undefined : onPress}
      hitSlop={10}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.base,
        { backgroundColor: background, opacity: disabled ? 0.4 : pressed ? 0.7 : 1 },
        style,
      ]}
    >
      <Ionicons name={name} size={size} color={iconColor} />
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  base: {
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
});

import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { TextField } from '@/components/ui/text-field';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { isValidEmail } from '@/lib/validation';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';

export default function SignInScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { signIn, supabaseEnabled } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit() {
    setError(null);
    if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
      setError('Informe um e-mail válido.');
      return;
    }
    if (!password) {
      setError('Informe sua senha.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await signIn(email, password);
      router.replace('/');
    } catch (submitError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(submitError));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll keyboardAvoiding padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScreenHeader title="Entrar" subtitle="Seu feed está esperando" />
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {!supabaseEnabled ? (
          <View style={[styles.demoBanner, { backgroundColor: colors.accentSoft }]}>
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.text}>
              Modo demonstração: qualquer e-mail e senha válidos criam uma sessão local. Nenhum dado
              é enviado para servidores.
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <TextField
          label="E-mail"
          value={email}
          onChangeText={setEmail}
          placeholder="voce@exemplo.com"
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          icon="mail-outline"
        />
        <TextField
          label="Senha"
          value={password}
          onChangeText={setPassword}
          placeholder="Sua senha"
          secure
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="password"
          textContentType="password"
          icon="lock-closed-outline"
        />

        {error ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}

        <Button label="Entrar" onPress={handleSubmit} loading={loading} size="lg" fullWidth />

        <View style={styles.footer}>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            Ainda não tem conta?
          </AppText>
          <Button
            label="Criar conta"
            onPress={() => router.replace('/(auth)/sign-up')}
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
    gap: Spacing.lg,
  },
  demoBanner: {
    padding: Spacing.md,
    borderRadius: 14,
  },
  footer: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.xs,
  },
});

import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { TextField } from '@/components/ui/text-field';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { isValidEmail, passwordError } from '@/lib/validation';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';

export default function SignUpScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { signUp, supabaseEnabled } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [termsError, setTermsError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit() {
    setError(null);
    setTermsError(null);
    if (!isValidEmail(email)) {
      setError('Informe um e-mail válido.');
      return;
    }
    const passwordIssue = passwordError(password);
    if (passwordIssue) {
      setError(passwordIssue);
      return;
    }
    if (password !== confirm) {
      setError('As senhas não coincidem.');
      return;
    }
    if (!accepted) {
      setTermsError('É necessário aceitar os termos e a política de privacidade.');
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await signUp(email, password);
      if (result.needsEmailConfirmation) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Confirme seu e-mail',
          'Enviamos um link de confirmação. Depois de confirmar, volte e entre na sua conta.',
          [{ text: 'Entendi', onPress: () => router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in') }],
        );
        return;
      }
      router.replace('/');
    } catch (submitError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(submitError));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll keyboardAvoiding padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScreenHeader title="Criar conta" subtitle="Leva menos de um minuto" />
      <View style={styles.content}>
        {!supabaseEnabled ? (
          <View style={[styles.demoBanner, { backgroundColor: colors.accentSoft }]}>
            <AppText variant="caption">
              Modo demonstração: a conta é local e nenhum dado sai do dispositivo. Você poderá
              configurar o Supabase depois.
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <TextField
          label="E-mail"
          value={email}
          onChangeText={setEmail}
          placeholder="voce@exemplo.com"
          keyboardType="email-address"
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="email"
          textContentType="emailAddress"
          icon="mail-outline"
        />
        <TextField
          label="Senha"
          value={password}
          onChangeText={setPassword}
          placeholder="Mínimo de 8 caracteres"
          secure
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="new-password"
          textContentType="newPassword"
          icon="lock-closed-outline"
          hint="Use pelo menos uma letra e um número."
        />
        <TextField
          label="Confirmar senha"
          value={confirm}
          onChangeText={setConfirm}
          placeholder="Repita a senha"
          secure
          autoCapitalize="none"
          autoComplete="new-password"
          textContentType="newPassword"
          icon="lock-closed-outline"
        />

        {error ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger}>
            {error}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}

        <Checkbox
          checked={accepted}
          onChange={(value) => {
            setAccepted(value);
            if (value) {
              setTermsError(null);
            }
          }}
          label="Li e aceito os Termos de Uso e a Política de Privacidade."
          description="Você pode revogar consentimentos opcionais a qualquer momento nas configurações."
          error={termsError}
        />
        <Button
          label="Ler Termos de Uso e Política de Privacidade"
          onPress={() => router.push('/(auth)/terms')}
          variant="ghost"
          size="sm"
        />
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted}>
          O DopamineMaxxing é restrito a maiores de 18 anos.
        </AppText>

        <Button
          label="Criar conta"
          onPress={handleSubmit}
          loading={loading}
          size="lg"
          fullWidth
        />

        <View style={styles.footer}>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            Já tem conta?
          </AppText>
          <Button
            label="Entrar"
            onPress={() => router.replace('/(auth)/sign-in')}
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
          />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
    gap: Spacing.lg,
  },
  demoBanner: {
    padding: Spacing.md,
    borderRadius: 14,
  },
  footer: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.xs,
  },
});

import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION } from '@/lib/validation';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

const SECTIONS: { title: string; body: string[] }[] = [
  {
    title: '1. Aceitação',
    body: [
      'Ao criar uma conta ou usar o DopamineMaxxing, você concorda com estes Termos de Uso e com a Política de Privacidade. Se não concordar, não utilize o app.',
    ],
  },
  {

import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Divider } from '@/components/ui/divider';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { NETWORK_LIST } from '@/constants/networks';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import type { NetworkAvailability, NetworkId } from '@/types/models';

const AVAILABILITY_LABEL: Record<NetworkAvailability, string> = {
  official: 'API oficial',
  limited: 'Acesso limitado',
  demo: 'Demonstração',
};

export default function ConnectNetworksScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { connections, connectNetwork, disconnectNetwork, loading } = useProfile();
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<NetworkId[]>([]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const initialized = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!loading && !initialized.current) {
      initialized.current = true;
      setSelected(connections.map((connection) => connection.network));
    }
  }, [connections, loading]);

  function toggle(network: NetworkId) {
    setSelected((current) =>
      current.includes(network) ? current.filter((item) => item !== network) : [...current, network],
    );
  }

  async function handleContinue() {
    if (selected.length === 0) {
      Alert.alert('Conecte pelo menos uma rede', 'Escolha uma rede para montar seu primeiro feed.');
      return;
    }
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const current = new Set(connections.map((connection) => connection.network));
      const next = new Set(selected);
      for (const network of current) {
        if (!next.has(network)) {
          await disconnectNetwork(network);
        }
      }
      for (const network of next) {
        if (!current.has(network)) {
          await connectNetwork(network);
        }
      }
      router.push('/(onboarding)/profile');
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível salvar as conexões', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <AppText variant="label" color={colors.primary}>
          Passo 1 de 2
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="title">Conecte suas redes</AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" color={colors.textSecondary}>
          Escolha as redes que você quer acompanhar. No modo demonstração, as conexões são
          simuladas e nenhuma credencial é armazenada.
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <View style={styles.content}>
        <Card padded={false}>
          {NETWORK_LIST.map((network, index) => {
            const isSelected = selected.includes(network.id);
            return (
              <View key={network.id}>
                <Pressable
                  accessibilityRole="checkbox"
                  accessibilityState={{ checked: isSelected }}
                  accessibilityLabel={`Conectar ${network.name}`}
                  onPress={() => toggle(network.id)}
                  style={({ pressed }) => [styles.row, pressed && { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}
                >
                  <View style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
                    <Ionicons name={network.icon} size={22} color={network.color} />
                  </View>
                  <View style={styles.rowTexts}>
                    <View style={styles.nameRow}>
                      <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{network.name}</AppText>
                      <View
                        style={[
                          styles.availability,
                          {
                            backgroundColor:
                              network.availability === 'official'
                                ? colors.accentSoft
                                : colors.surfaceAlt,
                          },
                        ]}
                      >
                        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.availabilityText}>
                          {AVAILABILITY_LABEL[network.availability]}
                        </AppText>
                      </View>
                    </View>
                    <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted} numberOfLines={2}>
                      {network.note}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.check,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: isSelected ? colors.primary : 'transparent',
                        borderColor: isSelected ? colors.primary : colors.borderStrong,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    {isSelected ? (
                      <Ionicons name="checkmark" size={16} color={colors.onPrimary} />
                    ) : null}
                  </View>
                </Pressable>
                {index < NETWORK_LIST.length - 1 ? <Divider /> : null}
              </View>
            );
          })}
        </Card>

        <View style={styles.quickActions}>
          <Button
            label="Selecionar todas"
            onPress={() => setSelected(NETWORK_LIST.map((network) => network.id))}
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            icon="checkmark-done-outline"
          />
          <Button
            label="Limpar"
            onPress={() => setSelected([])}
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            icon="close-outline"
          />
        </View>

        <View style={[styles.notice, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
          <Ionicons name="information-circle-outline" size={18} color={colors.textSecondary} />
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.noticeText}>
            Instagram, TikTok, X e Threads não oferecem API gratuita para o feed pessoal. O
            DopamineMaxxing trata essas conexões como demonstração até que integrações oficiais
            sejam habilitadas. Detalhes na tela Sobre após concluir o onboarding.
          </AppText>
        </View>

        <Button
          label={saving ? 'Salvando…' : 'Continuar'}
          onPress={handleContinue}
          loading={saving}
          size="lg"
          fullWidth
          icon="arrow-forward"
          iconPosition="right"
        />
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted} align="center">
          {selected.length === 0
            ? 'Selecione pelo menos uma rede para continuar.'
            : `${selected.length} ${selected.length === 1 ? 'rede selecionada' : 'redes selecionadas'}`}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
    paddingTop: Spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: Spacing.md,
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  content: {

import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { ProfileForm, type ProfileFormValues } from '@/components/profile/profile-form';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';

export default function OnboardingProfileScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { profile, saveProfile, saveConsents } = useProfile();

  async function handleSubmit({ input, consents }: ProfileFormValues) {
    await saveConsents(consents);
    await saveProfile(input);
    router.replace('/(tabs)/videos');
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <AppText variant="label" color={colors.primary}>
          Passo 2 de 2
        </AppText>
        <AppText variant="title">Crie seu perfil Dopamine</AppText>
        <AppText variant="body" color={colors.textSecondary}>
          Um perfil para todas as suas redes. Você poderá editar tudo depois em Configurações.
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <View style={styles.content}>
        <ProfileForm
          initial={profile}
          mode="onboarding"
          submitLabel="Concluir e abrir meu feed"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        />
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  header: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
    paddingTop: Spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: Spacing.md,
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  content: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.lg,
  },
});
--- src/app/(onboarding)/_layout.tsx
import { Redirect, Stack } from 'expo-router';

import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';

export default function OnboardingLayout() {
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const { loading, isOnboarded } = useProfile();

  if (status === 'loading' || loading) {
    return <LoadingView label="Preparando seu perfil…" />;
  }

  if (status === 'signedOut') {
    return <Redirect href="/(auth)/welcome" />;
  }

  if (isOnboarded) {
    return <Redirect href="/(tabs)/videos" />;
  }

  return <Stack screenOptions={{ headerShown: false }} />;
}

import * as ImagePicker from 'expo-image-picker';
import * as Location from 'expo-location';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { TextField } from '@/components/ui/text-field';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import {
  birthDateError,
  displayNameError,
  normalizeUsername,
  parseBirthDate,
  PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION,
  toBrDate,
  toIsoDate,
  usernameError,
} from '@/lib/validation';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import type { ConsentInput, DopamineProfile, ProfileInput } from '@/types/models';

export interface ProfileFormValues {
  input: ProfileInput;
  consents: ConsentInput[];
}

interface ProfileFormProps {
  initial?: DopamineProfile | null;
  mode: 'onboarding' | 'edit';
  submitLabel: string;
  submitting?: boolean;
  onSubmit: (values: ProfileFormValues) => Promise<void>;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

export function ProfileForm({
  initial,
  mode,
  submitLabel,
  submitting = false,
  onSubmit,
  onCancel,
}: ProfileFormProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { uploadAvatar } = useProfile();
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(initial?.displayName ?? '');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState(initial?.username ?? '');
  const [usernameTouched, setUsernameTouched] = useState(Boolean(initial?.username));
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState(initial?.birthDate ? toBrDate(initial.birthDate) : '');
  const [avatarUri, setAvatarUri] = useState<string | undefined>(initial?.avatarUrl);
  const [locationLabel, setLocationLabel] = useState(initial?.locationLabel ?? '');
  const [locationConsent, setLocationConsent] = useState(Boolean(initial?.locationConsent));
  const [termsAccepted, setTermsAccepted] = useState(mode === 'edit');
  const [personalization, setPersonalization] = useState(false);
  const [analytics, setAnalytics] = useState(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string | null>>({});
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);

  const busy = submitting || saving;

  function handleDisplayName(value: string) {
    setDisplayName(value);
    if (!usernameTouched) {
      setUsername(normalizeUsername(value));
    }
  }

  async function pickAvatar() {
    try {
      const permission = await ImagePicker.requestMediaLibraryPermissionsAsync();
      if (!permission.granted) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Permissão necessária',
          'Autorize o acesso à galeria para escolher uma foto de perfil.',
        );
        return;
      }
      const result = await ImagePicker.launchImageLibraryAsync({
        mediaTypes: ['images'],
        allowsEditing: true,
        aspect: [1, 1],
        quality: 0.6,
      });
      if (!result.canceled && result.assets[0]?.uri) {
        setAvatarUri(result.assets[0].uri);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível abrir a galeria', getErrorMessage(error));
    }
  }

  async function detectLocation() {
    setLocating(true);
    try {
      const permission = await Location.requestForegroundPermissionsAsync();
      if (!permission.granted) {
        Alert.alert(
          'Localização não autorizada',
          'Você pode continuar sem compartilhar sua localização.',
        );
        setLocationConsent(false);
        return;
      }
      const position = await Location.getCurrentPositionAsync({
        accuracy: Location.Accuracy.Balanced,
      });
      const places = await Location.reverseGeocodeAsync({
        latitude: position.coords.latitude,
        longitude: position.coords.longitude,
      });
      const place = places[0];
      const label = [place?.city ?? place?.subregion, place?.country]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(', ');
      if (label) {
        setLocationLabel(label);
        setLocationConsent(true);
      } else {
        setLocationLabel('Localização aproximada');
        setLocationConsent(true);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível obter a localização', getErrorMessage(error));
      setLocationConsent(false);
    } finally {
      setLocating(false);
    }
  }

  function handleLocationToggle(value: boolean) {
    if (!value) {
      setLocationConsent(false);
      setLocationLabel('');
      return;
    }
    if (locationLabel) {
      setLocationConsent(true);
      return;
    }
    detectLocation();
  }

  async function handleSubmit() {
    const nextErrors: Record<string, string | null> = {
      displayName: displayNameError(displayName),
      username: usernameError(username),
      birthDate: birthDateError(birthDate),
      terms: mode === 'onboarding' && !termsAccepted ? 'Aceite os termos para continuar.' : null,
      location:
        locationConsent && !locationLabel ? 'Detecte sua localização ou desative o compartilhamento.' : null,
    };
    setErrors(nextErrors);
    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      return;
    }

    const parsedDate = parseBirthDate(birthDate);
    if (!parsedDate) {
      return;
    }

    setSaving(true);
    try {
      let storedAvatar = initial?.avatarUrl;
      if (avatarUri && avatarUri !== initial?.avatarUrl) {
        storedAvatar = await uploadAvatar(avatarUri);
      }
      const input: ProfileInput = {
        displayName: displayName.trim(),
        username: normalizeUsername(username),
        birthDate: toIsoDate(parsedDate),
        avatarUrl: storedAvatar,
        locationLabel: locationConsent ? locationLabel : undefined,
        locationConsent,
        termsAccepted: mode === 'edit' ? true : termsAccepted,
        privacyPolicyVersion: PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION,
      };
      const consents: ConsentInput[] =
        mode === 'onboarding'
          ? [
              { purpose: 'essential', granted: true },
              { purpose: 'personalization', granted: personalization },
              { purpose: 'analytics', granted: analytics },
              { purpose: 'location', granted: locationConsent },
            ]
          : [{ purpose: 'location', granted: locationConsent }];
      await onSubmit({ input, consents });
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível salvar', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <View style={styles.root}>
      <View style={styles.avatarSection}>
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Escolher foto de perfil"
          onPress={pickAvatar}
          style={styles.avatarButton}
        >
          <Avatar name={displayName || 'Você'} uri={avatarUri} size={96} ringColor={colors.primary} />
          <View style={[styles.avatarEdit, { backgroundColor: colors.primary }]}>
            <Ionicons name="camera" size={16} color={colors.onPrimary} />
          </View>
        </Pressable>
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
          Toque para escolher uma foto (opcional)
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <TextField
        label="Nome de exibição"
        value={displayName}
        onChangeText={handleDisplayName}
        placeholder="Como você quer ser chamado"
        autoCapitalize="words"
        maxLength={80}
        error={errors.displayName}
        icon="person-outline"
      />
      <TextField
        label="Nome de usuário"
        value={username}
        onChangeText={(value) => {
          setUsernameTouched(true);
          setUsername(value);
        }}
        placeholder="seu_usuario"
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoCorrect={false}
        maxLength={30}
        error={errors.username}
        hint="Apenas letras minúsculas, números e _."
        icon="at-outline"
      />
      <TextField
        label="Data de nascimento"
        value={birthDate}
        onChangeText={setBirthDate}
        placeholder="DD/MM/AAAA"
        keyboardType="numbers-and-punctuation"
        maxLength={10}
        error={errors.birthDate}
        hint="O DopamineMaxxing é restrito a maiores de 18 anos."
        icon="calendar-outline"
      />

      <Card style={styles.locationCard}>
        <View style={styles.locationHeader}>
          <View style={styles.locationTexts}>
            <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Localização</AppText>
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
              Guardamos apenas cidade e país, nunca as coordenadas.
            </AppText>
          </View>
          <Ionicons name="location-outline" size={22} color={colors.primary} />
        </View>
        {locationLabel ? (
          <View style={[styles.locationChip, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
            <Ionicons name="pin" size={14} color={colors.primary} />
            <AppText variant="caption" style={styles.locationChipText}>
              {locationLabel}
            </AppText>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel="Remover localização"
              onPress={() => {
                setLocationConsent(false);
                setLocationLabel('');
              }}
              hitSlop={8}
            >
              <Ionicons name="close" size={16} color={colors.textMuted} />
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <View style={styles.locationActions}>
          <Button
            label={locating ? 'Detectando…' : 'Detectar localização'}
            onPress={detectLocation}
            variant="secondary"
            size="sm"
            loading={locating}
            icon="navigate-outline"
          />
          <Checkbox
            checked={locationConsent}
            onChange={handleLocationToggle}
            label="Compartilhar localização"
          />
        </View>
        {errors.location ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger}>
            {errors.location}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </Card>

      {mode === 'onboarding' ? (
        <Card style={styles.consentCard}>
          <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Privacidade e consentimentos</AppText>
          <Checkbox
            checked={termsAccepted}
            onChange={(value) => {
              setTermsAccepted(value);
              if (value) {
                setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, terms: null }));
              }
            }}
            label="Li e aceito os Termos de Uso e a Política de Privacidade."
            error={errors.terms}
          />
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Ler termos de uso e política de privacidade"
            onPress={() => router.push('/(auth)/terms')}
            style={styles.policyLink}
          >
            <Ionicons name="document-text-outline" size={15} color={colors.primary} />
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.primary}>
              Ler termos e política
            </AppText>
          </Pressable>
          <Checkbox
            checked={personalization}
            onChange={setPersonalization}
            label="Permitir personalização do feed"
            description="Usamos suas interações para ordenar o feed. Opcional."
          />
          <Checkbox
            checked={analytics}
            onChange={setAnalytics}
            label="Permitir métricas anônimas de uso"
            description="Ajuda a melhorar o app sem identificar você. Opcional."
          />
        </Card>
      ) : null}

      <Button
        label={busy ? 'Salvando…' : submitLabel}
        onPress={handleSubmit}
        loading={busy}
        size="lg"
        fullWidth
      />
      {onCancel ? (
        <Button label="Cancelar" onPress={onCancel} variant="ghost" fullWidth />
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

interface VideoFeedItemProps {
  post: FeedPost;
  height: number;
  active: boolean;
  playing: boolean;
  muted: boolean;
  player: VideoPlayer | null;
  onTogglePlay: () => void;
  onToggleMute: () => void;
  onLike: () => void;
  onComment: () => void;
  onRepost: () => void;
  onShare: () => void;
}

  post,
  height,
  active,

  muted,
  player,
  onTogglePlay,
  onToggleMute,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onRepost,
  onShare,
}: VideoFeedItemProps) {

  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();

  return (

          transition={animationsEnabled ? 250 : 0}

          recyclingKey={post.id}

        />

      {active && playing && player ? (

  );

import { Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { getNetwork } from '@/constants/networks';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { formatCount } from '@/lib/format';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import type { FeedPost } from '@/types/models';

interface FeedActionsProps {
  post: FeedPost;
  orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  overlay?: boolean;
  onLike: () => void;
  onComment: () => void;
  onRepost: () => void;
  onShare: () => void;
}

export function FeedActions({
  post,
  orientation = 'horizontal',
  overlay = false,
  onLike,
  onComment,
  onRepost,
  onShare,
}: FeedActionsProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const meta = getNetwork(post.network);
  const baseColor = overlay ? '#FFFFFF' : colors.text;
  const mutedColor = overlay ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.86)' : colors.textSecondary;
  const likeCount = post.likes;
  const repostCount = post.reposts;

  return (
    <View style={orientation === 'vertical' ? styles.vertical : styles.horizontal}>
      <Action
        icon={post.likedByMe ? 'heart' : 'heart-outline'}
        color={post.likedByMe ? '#FF4D6D' : baseColor}
        mutedColor={mutedColor}
        label="Curtir"
        count={formatCount(likeCount)}
        orientation={orientation}
        overlay={overlay}
        active={post.likedByMe}
        onPress={onLike}
      />
      {meta.supportsComment ? (
        <Action
          icon="chatbubble-outline"
          color={baseColor}
          mutedColor={mutedColor}
          label="Comentários"
          count={formatCount(post.comments)}
          orientation={orientation}
          overlay={overlay}
          onPress={onComment}
        />
      ) : null}
      {meta.supportsRepost ? (
        <Action
          icon="repeat"
          color={post.repostedByMe ? '#34D399' : baseColor}
          mutedColor={mutedColor}
          label="Repostar"
          count={formatCount(repostCount)}
          orientation={orientation}
          overlay={overlay}
          active={post.repostedByMe}
          onPress={onRepost}
        />
      ) : null}
      <Action
        icon="paper-plane-outline"
        color={baseColor}
        mutedColor={mutedColor}
        label="Compartilhar"
        count=""
        orientation={orientation}
        overlay={overlay}
        onPress={onShare}
      />
    </View>
  );
}

interface ActionProps {
  icon: React.ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  color: string;
  mutedColor: string;
  label: string;
  count: string;
  orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  overlay: boolean;
  active?: boolean;
  onPress: () => void;
}

function Action({
  icon,
  color,
  mutedColor,
  label,
  count,
  orientation,
  overlay,
  active = false,
  onPress,
}: ActionProps) {
  const vertical = orientation === 'vertical';
  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={count ? `${label}, ${count}` : label}
      accessibilityState={active ? { selected: true } : undefined}
      onPress={onPress}
      hitSlop={8}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        vertical ? styles.actionVertical : styles.actionHorizontal,
        pressed && { opacity: 0.65 },
      ]}
    >
      <Ionicons
        name={icon}
        size={vertical ? 28 : 21}
        color={color}
        style={overlay ? styles.iconShadow : undefined}
      />
      {count ? (
        <AppText
          variant="caption"
          color={vertical ? mutedColor : mutedColor}
          style={[
            vertical ? styles.countVertical : styles.countHorizontal,
            overlay ? styles.textShadow : undefined,
          ]}
        >
          {count}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  vertical: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.lg,
  },
  horizontal: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.xl,
  },
  actionVertical: {
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 2,
    minWidth: 48,
  },
  actionHorizontal: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 5,
  },
  countVertical: {
    fontSize: 11,
    fontWeight: '700',
  },
  countHorizontal: {
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: '600',
  },
  iconShadow: {
    textShadowColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)',
    textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 },
    textShadowRadius: 4,
  },
  textShadow: {
    textShadowColor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)',
    textShadowOffset: { width: 0, height: 1 },
    textShadowRadius: 4,
  },
});

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useFocusEffect, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useVideoPlayer } from 'expo-video';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { AppState, FlatList, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/empty-state';
import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { ShareSheet } from '@/components/feed/share-sheet';
import { VideoFeedItem } from '@/components/feed/video-feed-item';
import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { IconButton } from '@/components/ui/icon-button';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useFeed } from '@/hooks/use-feed';
import { usePerformance } from '@/hooks/use-performance';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import type { FeedPost } from '@/types/models';

const VIEWABILITY_CONFIG = { itemVisiblePercentThreshold: 60 };

export default function VideosScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { autoplay, performanceMode, listProps } = usePerformance();
  const { posts, loading, error, refresh, toggleLike, toggleRepost } = useFeed('video');
  const [height, setHeight] = useState(0);
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true);
  const [userPlayOverride, setUserPlayOverride] = useState(false);
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(true);
  const [appActive, setAppActive] = useState(AppState.currentState === 'active');
  const [sharePost, setSharePost] = useState<FeedPost | null>(null);

  const player = useVideoPlayer(null, (instance) => {
    instance.loop = true;
    instance.muted = true;
  });

  const safeActiveIndex = posts.length > 0 ? Math.min(activeIndex, posts.length - 1) : 0;
  const activePost = posts[safeActiveIndex] ?? null;
  const activePostId = activePost?.id ?? null;
  const activeMediaUrl = activePost?.mediaUrl ?? null;
  const shouldPlay =
    Boolean(activeMediaUrl) &&
    focused &&
    appActive &&
    (autoplay ? !userPlayOverride : userPlayOverride);

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      setFocused(true);
      return () => setFocused(false);
    }, []),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const subscription = AppState.addEventListener('change', (state) => {
      setAppActive(state === 'active');
    });
    return () => subscription.remove();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeMediaUrl) {
      player.pause();
      return;
    }
    player.replace(activeMediaUrl);
  }, [activePostId, activeMediaUrl, player]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (shouldPlay) {
      player.play();
    } else {
      player.pause();
    }
  }, [shouldPlay, player]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // O player do expo-video expõe muted como propriedade mutável.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/immutability
    player.muted = muted;
  }, [muted, player]);

  const onViewableItemsChanged = useCallback(
    ({ viewableItems }: { viewableItems: { index?: number }[] }) => {
      const first = viewableItems[0];
      if (typeof first?.index === 'number') {
        setActiveIndex(first.index);
        setUserPlayOverride(false);
      }
    },
    [],
  );

  const getItemLayout = useCallback(
    (_: ArrayLike<FeedPost> | null | undefined, index: number) => ({
      length: height,
      offset: height * index,
      index,
    }),
    [height],
  );

  const renderItem = useCallback(
    ({ item, index }: { item: FeedPost; index: number }) => (
      <VideoFeedItem
        post={item}
        height={height}
        active={index === safeActiveIndex}
        playing={index === safeActiveIndex && shouldPlay}
        muted={muted}
        player={index === safeActiveIndex ? player : null}
        onTogglePlay={() => setUserPlayOverride((current) => !current)}
        onToggleMute={() => setMuted((current) => !current)}
        onLike={() => toggleLike(item.id)}
        onComment={() => router.push(`/post/${item.id}`)}
        onRepost={() => toggleRepost(item.id)}
        onShare={() => setSharePost(item)}
      />
    ),
    [height, muted, player, router, safeActiveIndex, shouldPlay, toggleLike, toggleRepost],
  );

  if (loading && posts.length === 0) {
    return <LoadingView label="Montando seu feed de vídeos…" />;
  }

  if (error && posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.state, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="cloud-offline-outline"
          title="Não foi possível carregar o feed"
          description={error}
          actionLabel="Tentar novamente"
          onAction={refresh}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (!loading && posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.state, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="videocam-off-outline"
          title="Nenhum vídeo por aqui"
          description="Conecte uma rede social para começar a montar seu feed único."
          actionLabel="Gerenciar conexões"
          onAction={() => router.push('/(tabs)/settings')}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View
      style={[styles.container, { backgroundColor: '#000000' }]}
      onLayout={(event) => {
        const next = event.nativeEvent.layout.height;
        if (next !== height) {
          setHeight(next);
        }
      }}
    >
      {height > 0 ? (
        <FlatList
          data={posts}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
          pagingEnabled
          snapToInterval={height}
          decelerationRate="fast"
          disableIntervalMomentum
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
          bounces={false}
          getItemLayout={getItemLayout}
          onViewableItemsChanged={onViewableItemsChanged}
          viewabilityConfig={VIEWABILITY_CONFIG}
          extraData={`${safeActiveIndex}-${shouldPlay}-${muted}`}
          {...listProps}
        />
      ) : null}

      <View style={styles.floatingActions} pointerEvents="box-none">
        {performanceMode ? (
          <View style={styles.performancePill}>
            <Ionicons name="speedometer-outline" size={13} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <AppText variant="caption" color="#FFFFFF" style={styles.performanceText}>
              Modo desempenho
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}
        <IconButton
          name="refresh"
          accessibilityLabel="Atualizar feed"
          onPress={refresh}
          variant="overlay"
          size={18}

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/empty-state';
import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { ShareSheet } from '@/components/feed/share-sheet';
import { TextFeedItem } from '@/components/feed/text-feed-item';
import { getNetwork } from '@/constants/networks';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useFeed } from '@/hooks/use-feed';
import type { FeedPost, NetworkId } from '@/types/models';

type Filter = 'all' | NetworkId;

export default function TextsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { posts, loading, refreshing, error, refresh, toggleLike, toggleRepost } = useFeed('text');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>('all');
  const [sharePost, setSharePost] = useState<FeedPost | null>(null);

  const networks = useMemo(() => {
    const unique = new Set<NetworkId>();
    posts.forEach((post) => unique.add(post.network));
    return [...unique];
  }, [posts]);

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () => (filter === 'all' ? posts : posts.filter((post) => post.network === filter)),
    [filter, posts],
  );

  if (loading && posts.length === 0) {
    return <LoadingView label="Montando seu feed de textos…" />;
  }

  if (error && posts.length === 0) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]} edges={['top']}>
        <EmptyState
          icon="cloud-offline-outline"
          title="Não foi possível carregar o feed"
          description={error}
          actionLabel="Tentar novamente"
          onAction={refresh}
        />
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]} edges={['top']}>
      <FlatList
        data={filtered}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={({ item }) => (
          <TextFeedItem
            post={item}
            onLike={() => toggleLike(item.id)}
            onComment={() => router.push(`/post/${item.id}`)}
            onRepost={() => toggleRepost(item.id)}
            onShare={() => setSharePost(item)}
          />
        )}
        contentContainerStyle={styles.content}
        ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
        refreshControl={
          <RefreshControl
            refreshing={refreshing}
            onRefresh={refresh}
            tintColor={colors.primary}
            colors={[colors.primary]}
          />
        }
        ListHeaderComponent={
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <View>
              <AppText variant="title">Textos</AppText>
              <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
                X, Threads, Instagram e mais — sem ruído.
              </AppText>
            </View>
            {error ? (
              <View style={[styles.errorBanner, { backgroundColor: colors.dangerSoft }]}>
                <Ionicons name="alert-circle-outline" size={16} color={colors.danger} />
                <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger} style={styles.errorText}>
                  {error}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ) : null}
            <ScrollView
              horizontal
              showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
              contentContainerStyle={styles.filters}
            >
              <FilterChip
                label="Todos"
                active={filter === 'all'}
                onPress={() => setFilter('all')}
              />
              {networks.map((network) => (
                <FilterChip
                  key={network}
                  label={getNetwork(network).shortName}
                  color={getNetwork(network).color}
                  active={filter === network}
                  onPress={() => setFilter(network)}
                />
              ))}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        }
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <EmptyState
            icon="chatbox-ellipses-outline"
            title={filter === 'all' ? 'Nenhum texto por aqui' : 'Nada nesta rede ainda'}
            description={
              filter === 'all'
                ? 'Conecte uma rede social ou puxe para atualizar.'
                : 'Tente outro filtro ou puxe para atualizar.'
            }
            actionLabel={filter === 'all' ? 'Gerenciar conexões' : 'Ver todos'}
            onAction={
              filter === 'all'
                ? () => router.push('/(tabs)/settings')
                : () => setFilter('all')
            }
          />
        }
      />
      <ShareSheet post={sharePost} visible={Boolean(sharePost)} onClose={() => setSharePost(null)} />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function FilterChip({
  label,
  color,
  active,
  onPress,
}: {
  label: string;
  color?: string;
  active: boolean;
  onPress: () => void;
}) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityState={{ selected: active }}
      onPress={onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [
        styles.chip,
        {
          backgroundColor: active ? colors.primary : colors.surface,
          borderColor: active ? colors.primary : colors.border,
          opacity: pressed ? 0.8 : 1,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {color ? <View style={[styles.dot, { backgroundColor: color }]} /> : null}
      <AppText variant="caption" color={active ? colors.onPrimary : colors.textSecondary} style={styles.chipText}>
        {label}
      </AppText>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
    paddingBottom: Spacing.xxxl,
  },
  header: {
    gap: Spacing.md,
    marginBottom: Spacing.lg,
  },
  filters: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
    paddingVertical: 2,
  },
  chip: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.xs,
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.md,
    paddingVertical: 7,
    borderRadius: Radius.pill,
    borderWidth: 1,
  },
  chipText: {
    fontSize: 12,
    fontWeight: '600',
  },
  dot: {
    width: 7,
    height: 7,
    borderRadius: 4,
  },
  separator: {
    height: Spacing.md,
  },
  errorBanner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
    padding: Spacing.md,
    borderRadius: Radius.md,
  },
  errorText: {
    flex: 1,
  },
});

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { Redirect, Tabs } from 'expo-router';
import { StyleSheet } from 'react-native';

import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';

import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';

export default function TabsLayout() {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const { loading, isOnboarded } = useProfile();

  if (status === 'loading' || loading) {
    return <LoadingView label="Preparando seu feed…" />;
  }

  if (status === 'signedOut') {
    return <Redirect href="/(auth)/welcome" />;
  }

  if (!isOnboarded) {
    return <Redirect href="/(onboarding)/connect" />;
  }

  return (
    <Tabs
      screenOptions={{
        headerShown: false,
        tabBarActiveTintColor: colors.primary,
        tabBarInactiveTintColor: colors.textMuted,
        tabBarHideOnKeyboard: true,
        tabBarStyle: {
          backgroundColor: colors.backgroundElevated,
          borderTopColor: colors.border,
          borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
        },
        tabBarLabelStyle: {
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: '600',
        },
        tabBarItemStyle: {
          paddingVertical: 4,
        },
        sceneStyle: {
          backgroundColor: colors.background,
        },
      }}
    >
      <Tabs.Screen
        name="videos"
        options={{
          title: 'Vídeos',
          tabBarIcon: ({ color, size, focused }) => (
            <Ionicons name={focused ? 'play-circle' : 'play-circle-outline'} size={size} color={color as string} />
          ),
        }}
      />
      <Tabs.Screen
        name="texts"
        options={{
          title: 'Textos',
          tabBarIcon: ({ color, size, focused }) => (
            <Ionicons name={focused ? 'reader' : 'reader-outline'} size={size} color={color as string} />
          ),
        }}
      />
      <Tabs.Screen
        name="profile"
        options={{
          title: 'Perfil',
          tabBarIcon: ({ color, size, focused }) => (
            <Ionicons name={focused ? 'person-circle' : 'person-circle-outline'} size={size} color={color as string} />
          ),
        }}
      />
      <Tabs.Screen
        name="settings"
        options={{
          title: 'Config.',
          tabBarIcon: ({ color, size, focused }) => (
            <Ionicons name={focused ? 'settings' : 'settings-outline'} size={size} color={color as string} />
          ),
        }}
      />
    </Tabs>
  );
}
