```
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/empty-state';
import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { ProfileForm, type ProfileFormValues } from '@/components/profile/profile-form';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';

export default function EditProfileScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { profile, loading, saveProfile, saveConsents } = useProfile();

  async function handleSubmit({ input, consents }: ProfileFormValues) {
    await saveProfile(input);
    await saveConsents(consents);
    router.back();
  }

  if (loading && !profile) {
    return <LoadingView label="Carregando perfil…" />;
  }

  if (!profile) {
    return (
      <Screen>
        <EmptyState
          icon="person-circle-outline"
          title="Perfil não encontrado"
          description="Complete seu perfil para editá-lo."
          actionLabel="Criar perfil"
          onAction={() => router.replace('/(onboarding)/profile')}
        />
      </Screen>
    );
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScreenHeader title="Editar perfil" subtitle="Seus dados e sua identidade" />
      <View style={styles.content}>
        <ProfileForm
          initial={profile}
          mode="edit"
          submitLabel="Salvar alterações"
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          onCancel={() => router.back()}
        />
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
  },
});
--- src/app/settings/connected.tsx
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { NETWORK_LIST } from '@/constants/networks';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import type { NetworkId } from '@/types/models';

export default function ConnectedNetworksScreen() {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { connections, connectNetwork, disconnectNetwork } = useProfile();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<NetworkId | null>(null);

  async function toggle(network: NetworkId, connected: boolean) {
    setBusy(network);
    try {
      if (connected) {
        await connectNetwork(network);
      } else {
        await disconnectNetwork(network);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível atualizar a conexão', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScreenHeader title="Redes conectadas" subtitle="Gerencie suas conexões" />
      <View style={styles.content}>
        <View style={[styles.notice, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
          <Ionicons name="lock-closed-outline" size={18} color={colors.textSecondary} />
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.noticeText}>
            Nenhuma credencial de rede social é armazenada no dispositivo ou no banco. As conexões
            demonstrativas existem para validar o fluxo do produto.
          </AppText>
        </View>

        {NETWORK_LIST.map((network) => {
          const connection = connections.find((item) => item.network === network.id);
          const connected = Boolean(connection);
          return (
            <Card key={network.id} style={styles.card}>
              <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
                <View style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
                  <Ionicons name={network.icon} size={22} color={network.color} />
                </View>
                <View style={styles.texts}>
                  <View style={styles.nameRow}>
                    <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{network.name}</AppText>
                    <View
                      style={[
                        styles.badge,
                        {
                          backgroundColor:
                            network.availability === 'official'
                              ? colors.accentSoft
                              : colors.surfaceAlt,
                        },
                      ]}
                    >
                      <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.badgeText}>
                        {network.availability === 'official'
                          ? 'API oficial'
                          : network.availability === 'limited'
                            ? 'Limitada'
                            : 'Demonstração'}
                      </AppText>
                    </View>
                  </View>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted}>
                    {network.note}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>
              <View style={styles.actions}>
                <View style={styles.status}>
                  <View
                    style={[
                      styles.statusDot,
                      { backgroundColor: connected ? colors.success : colors.textMuted },
                    ]}
                  />
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
                    {connected ? 'Conectada' : 'Não conectada'}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
                <Button
                  label={connected ? 'Desconectar' : 'Conectar'}
                  onPress={() => toggle(network.id, !connected)}
                  variant={connected ? 'outline' : 'secondary'}
                  size="sm"
                  loading={busy === network.id}
                />
              </View>
            </Card>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
    gap: Spacing.md,
  },
  notice: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
    padding: Spacing.md,
    borderRadius: Radius.md,
  },
  noticeText: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  card: {
    gap: Spacing.md,
  },
  cardHeader: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: Spacing.md,
    alignItems: 'flex-start',
  },
  iconWrap: {
    width: 44,
    height: 44,
    borderRadius: Radius.sm,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  texts: {
    flex: 1,
    gap: 3,
  },
  nameRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
    flexWrap: 'wrap',
  },
  badge: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.sm,
    paddingVertical: 1,
    borderRadius: Radius.pill,
  },
  badgeText: {
    fontSize: 10,

--- src/app/settings/privacy.tsx
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, StyleSheet, Switch, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { ScreenHeader } from '@/components/ui/screen-header';
import { SettingsGroup, SettingsRow } from '@/components/ui/settings-row';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION } from '@/lib/validation';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import type { ConsentInput, ConsentPurpose } from '@/types/models';

const RIGHTS = [
  'Confirmação da existência de tratamento',
  'Acesso aos dados',
  'Correção de dados incompletos ou desatualizados',
  'Anonimização, bloqueio ou eliminação de dados desnecessários',
  'Portabilidade dos dados',
  'Eliminação dos dados tratados com consentimento',
  'Informação sobre compartilhamento de dados',
  'Revogação do consentimento a qualquer momento',
];

export default function PrivacyScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { consents, saveConsents, saveProfile, profile } = useProfile();
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<{
    personalization: boolean;
    analytics: boolean;
    location: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  const byPurpose = new Map(consents.map((consent) => [consent.purpose, consent.granted]));
  const personalization = draft?.personalization ?? Boolean(byPurpose.get('personalization'));
  const analytics = draft?.analytics ?? Boolean(byPurpose.get('analytics'));
  const location = draft?.location ?? Boolean(byPurpose.get('location'));

  async function persist(next: { personalization: boolean; analytics: boolean; location: boolean }) {
    setSaving(true);
    const payload: ConsentInput[] = [
      { purpose: 'essential', granted: true },
      { purpose: 'personalization', granted: next.personalization },
      { purpose: 'analytics', granted: next.analytics },
      { purpose: 'location', granted: next.location },
    ];
    try {
      await saveConsents(payload);
      if (!next.location && profile?.locationConsent) {
        await saveProfile({
          displayName: profile.displayName,
          username: profile.username,
          birthDate: profile.birthDate,
          avatarUrl: profile.avatarUrl,
          locationConsent: false,
          termsAccepted: true,
          privacyPolicyVersion: PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION,
        });
      }
      setDraft(null);
    } catch (error) {
      setDraft(null);
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível salvar o consentimento', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  function toggle(purpose: ConsentPurpose, value: boolean) {
    if (purpose === 'essential') return;
    const next = { personalization, analytics, location, [purpose]: value };
    setDraft(next);
    persist(next);
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll padded={false} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <ScreenHeader title="Privacidade e LGPD" subtitle="Seus dados, suas escolhas" />
      <View style={styles.content}>
        <Card style={styles.introCard}>
          <View style={[styles.introIcon, { backgroundColor: colors.accentSoft }]}>
            <Ionicons name="shield-checkmark-outline" size={24} color={colors.accent} />
          </View>
          <View style={styles.introTexts}>
            <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Privacidade por design</AppText>
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
              Coletamos o mínimo necessário para o app funcionar. Consentimentos opcionais podem ser
              revogados a qualquer momento, sem perda de acesso às funções essenciais.
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </Card>

        <SettingsGroup title="Consentimentos" footer={`Versão da política: ${PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION}`}>
          <SettingsRow
            icon="lock-closed-outline"
            title="Essenciais"
            subtitle="Autenticação, segurança e funcionamento do feed"
            right={
              <View style={[styles.fixedBadge, { backgroundColor: colors.accentSoft }]}>
                <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.accent} style={styles.fixedText}>
                  Sempre ativos
                </AppText>
              </View>
            }
          />
          <SettingsRow
            icon="sparkles-outline"
            title="Personalização"
            subtitle="Usar interações para ordenar seu feed"
            right={
              <Switch
                value={personalization}
                disabled={saving}
                onValueChange={(value) => toggle('personalization', value)}
                trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
                thumbColor={personalization ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
              />
            }
          />
          <SettingsRow
            icon="bar-chart-outline"
            title="Métricas anônimas"
            subtitle="Ajudar a melhorar o app sem identificar você"
            right={
              <Switch
                value={analytics}
                disabled={saving}
                onValueChange={(value) => toggle('analytics', value)}
                trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
                thumbColor={analytics ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
              />
            }
          />
          <SettingsRow
            icon="location-outline"
            title="Localização"
            subtitle={
              profile?.locationConsent && profile.locationLabel
                ? `Compartilhada: ${profile.locationLabel}`
                : 'Nenhuma localização armazenada. Ative em Editar perfil.'
            }
            right={
              <Switch
                value={location}
                disabled={saving || !location}
                onValueChange={(value) => toggle('location', value)}
                trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
                thumbColor={location ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
              />
            }
            last
          />
        </SettingsGroup>

        <View style={styles.section}>
          <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Seus direitos</AppText>
          <Card style={styles.rightsCard}>
            {RIGHTS.map((right) => (
              <View key={right} style={styles.rightRow}>
                <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle-outline" size={17} color={colors.success} />
                <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.rightText}>
                  {right}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            ))}
          </Card>
        </View>

        <Card style={styles.controllerCard}>
          <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Controlador de dados</AppText>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            DopamineMaxxing · DPO: [preencher contato antes da publicação]
          </AppText>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            Você pode solicitar acesso, correção, portabilidade ou exclusão a qualquer momento pelas
            opções de exportação e exclusão em Configurações. Responderemos em até 15 dias.
          </AppText>
        </Card>

        <Button
          label="Ler política de privacidade completa"
          onPress={() => router.push('/settings/privacy-policy')}
          variant="secondary"
          fullWidth
        />
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {
    padding: Spacing.lg,
    gap: Spacing.xl,
  },
  introCard: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    gap: Spacing.md,
    alignItems: 'flex-start',
  },
  introIcon: {
    width: 48,
    height: 48,
    borderRadius: Radius.md,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  introTexts: {
    flex: 1,
    gap: 3,
  },
  fixedBadge: {
    paddingHorizontal: Spacing.sm,
    paddingVertical: 3,
    borderRadius: Radius.pill,
  },
  fixedText: {
    fontSize: 10,
  },
  section: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  rightsCard: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  rightRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'flex-start',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  rightText: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  controllerCard: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
});

export default function PrivacyPolicyScreen() {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (

                {paragraph}

            ))}
          </View>
        ))}

        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted} align="center">
          Última atualização: {PRIVACY_POLICY_VERSION}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </Screen>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  content: {

  summary: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  section: {
    gap: Spacing.sm,

  paragraph: {
    lineHeight: 20,
  },
});

import { Image } from 'expo-image';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  FlatList,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { EmptyState } from '@/components/ui/empty-state';
import { FeedActions } from '@/components/feed/feed-actions';
import { IconButton } from '@/components/ui/icon-button';
import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { NetworkBadge } from '@/components/ui/network-badge';
import { PostAuthorRow } from '@/components/feed/post-author-row';
import { ShareSheet } from '@/components/feed/share-sheet';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { commentError, MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH } from '@/lib/validation';
import { useComments } from '@/hooks/use-comments';
import { useRepository } from '@/hooks/use-repository';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import type { Comment, FeedPost } from '@/types/models';

export default function CommentsScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const repository = useRepository();
  const { comments, loading: commentsLoading, submitting, error, addComment, deleteComment } =
    useComments(id);
  const [post, setPost] = useState<FeedPost | null>(null);
  const [loadedPostId, setLoadedPostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [postError, setPostError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
  const [composerError, setComposerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [shareOpen, setShareOpen] = useState(false);
  const likeBusy = useRef(false);
  const repostBusy = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!repository) {
      return;
    }
    repository
      .getPost(id)
      .then((data) => {
        if (active) {
          setPost(data);
          setPostError(data ? null : 'Post não encontrado.');
        }
      })
      .catch((loadError) => {
        if (active) {
          setPostError(getErrorMessage(loadError));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) {
          setLoadedPostId(id);
        }
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [id, repository]);

  const postLoading = Boolean(repository) && loadedPostId !== id;

  const handleLike = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!post || !repository || likeBusy.current) {
      return;
    }
    likeBusy.current = true;
    const previous = post;
    const nextLiked = !post.likedByMe;
    setPost({
      ...post,
      likedByMe: nextLiked,
      likes: Math.max(0, post.likes + (nextLiked ? 1 : -1)),
    });
    try {
      await repository.toggleLike(post.id);
    } catch (likeError) {
      setPost(previous);
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível curtir', getErrorMessage(likeError));
    } finally {
      likeBusy.current = false;
    }
  }, [post, repository]);

  const handleRepost = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!post || !repository || repostBusy.current) {
      return;
    }
    repostBusy.current = true;
    const previous = post;
    const nextReposted = !post.repostedByMe;
    setPost({
      ...post,
      repostedByMe: nextReposted,
      reposts: Math.max(0, post.reposts + (nextReposted ? 1 : -1)),
    });
    try {
      await repository.toggleRepost(post.id);
    } catch (repostError) {
      setPost(previous);
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível repostar', getErrorMessage(repostError));
    } finally {
      repostBusy.current = false;
    }
  }, [post, repository]);

  async function handleSend() {
    const issue = commentError(body);
    if (issue) {
      setComposerError(issue);
      return;
    }
    setComposerError(null);
    const created = await addComment(body);
    if (created) {
      setBody('');
      setPost((current) =>
        current ? { ...current, comments: current.comments + 1 } : current,
      );
    }
  }

  function handleDelete(comment: Comment) {
    Alert.alert('Excluir comentário?', 'Ele será removido do seu feed.', [
      { text: 'Cancelar', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Excluir',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          const deleted = await deleteComment(comment.id);
          if (deleted) {
            setPost((current) =>
              current ? { ...current, comments: Math.max(0, current.comments - 1) } : current,
            );
          }
        },
      },
    ]);
  }

  if (postLoading) {
    return <LoadingView label="Abrindo post…" />;
  }

  if (!post) {
    return (
      <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]} edges={['top']}>
        <View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: colors.border }]}>
          <IconButton name="chevron-back" accessibilityLabel="Voltar" onPress={() => router.back()} />
          <AppText variant="heading">Comentários</AppText>
          <View style={styles.headerSpacer} />
        </View>
        <EmptyState
          icon="alert-circle-outline"
          title="Post indisponível"
          description={postError ?? 'Não encontramos este post.'}
          actionLabel="Voltar"
          onAction={() => router.back()}
        />
      </SafeAreaView>
    );
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: colors.background }]} edges={['top', 'bottom']}>
      <View style={[styles.header, { borderBottomColor: colors.border }]}>
        <IconButton name="chevron-back" accessibilityLabel="Voltar" onPress={() => router.back()} />
        <View style={styles.headerTitle}>
          <AppText variant="heading">Comentários</AppText>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            {post.comments} {post.comments === 1 ? 'comentário' : 'comentários'}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <IconButton
          name="paper-plane-outline"
          accessibilityLabel="Compartilhar post"
          onPress={() => setShareOpen(true)}
        />
      </View>

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        style={styles.flex}
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <FlatList
          data={comments}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
          contentContainerStyle={styles.listContent}
          ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
          ListHeaderComponent={
            <View style={styles.listHeader}>
              <Card style={styles.postCard}>
                <View style={styles.postTopRow}>
                  <PostAuthorRow post={post} />
                  <NetworkBadge network={post.network} />
                </View>
                <AppText variant="body" style={styles.postCaption}>
                  {post.caption}
                </AppText>
                {post.kind === 'video' && post.thumbnailUrl ? (
                  <View style={styles.thumbnailWrap}>
                    <Image
                      source={{ uri: post.thumbnailUrl }}
                      style={styles.thumbnail}
                      contentFit="cover"
                      transition={180}
                      recyclingKey={post.id}
                    />
                    <View style={styles.thumbnailOverlay}>
                      <Ionicons name="play-circle" size={34} color="#FFFFFF" />
                    </View>
                  </View>
                ) : null}
                <View style={[styles.postActions, { borderTopColor: colors.border }]}>
                  <FeedActions
                    post={post}
                    orientation="horizontal"
                    onLike={handleLike}
                    onComment={() => undefined}
                    onRepost={handleRepost}
                    onShare={() => setShareOpen(true)}
                  />
                </View>
              </Card>

              <View style={styles.commentsTitleRow}>
                <AppText variant="bodyStrong">Comentários</AppText>
                {commentsLoading ? <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.primary} /> : null}
              </View>
              {error ? (
                <View style={[styles.errorBanner, { backgroundColor: colors.dangerSoft }]}>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger}>
                    {error}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              ) : null}
            </View>
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => (
            <View style={styles.commentRow}>
              <Avatar name={item.authorName} uri={item.authorAvatarUrl} size={38} />
              <View style={styles.commentBody}>
                <View style={styles.commentHeader}>
                  <AppText variant="bodyStrong" numberOfLines={1}>
                    {item.authorName}
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted}>
                    @{item.authorHandle} · {formatRelativeTime(item.createdAt)}
                  </AppText>
                  {item.isMine ? (
                    <Pressable
                      accessibilityRole="button"
                      accessibilityLabel="Excluir comentário"
                      onPress={() => handleDelete(item)}
                      hitSlop={8}
                      style={styles.deleteButton}
                    >
                      <Ionicons name="trash-outline" size={15} color={colors.textMuted} />
                    </Pressable>
                  ) : null}
                </View>
                <AppText variant="body" style={styles.commentText}>
                  {item.body}
                </AppText>
              </View>
            </View>
          )}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            commentsLoading ? undefined : (
              <View style={styles.emptyComments}>
                <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary} align="center">
                  Nenhum comentário ainda. Comece a conversa.
                </AppText>
              </View>
            )
          }
        />

        <View style={[styles.composer, { borderTopColor: colors.border, backgroundColor: colors.backgroundElevated }]}>
          {composerError ? (
            <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger} style={styles.composerError}>
              {composerError}
            </AppText>
          ) : null}
          <View style={styles.composerRow}>
            <TextInput
              value={body}
              onChangeText={(value) => {
                setBody(value);
                if (composerError) {
                  setComposerError(null);
                }
              }}
              placeholder="Escreva um comentário…"
              placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
              multiline
              maxLength={MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH}
              style={[
                styles.input,
                {
                  backgroundColor: colors.surface,
                  borderColor: colors.border,
                  color: colors.text,
                },
              ]}
              accessibilityLabel="Escreva um comentário"
            />
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel="Enviar comentário"
              accessibilityState={{ disabled: submitting || !body.trim() }}
              onPress={submitting || !body.trim() ? undefined : handleSend}
              style={({ pressed }) => [
                styles.sendButton,
                {
                  backgroundColor: body.trim() ? colors.primary : colors.surfaceAlt,
                  opacity: pressed ? 0.8 : 1,
                },
              ]}
            >
              {submitting ? (
                <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.onPrimary} />
              ) : (
                <Ionicons
                  name="arrow-up"
                  size={20}
                  color={body.trim() ? colors.onPrimary : colors.textMuted}
                />
              )}
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>

      <ShareSheet post={post} visible={shareOpen} onClose={() => setShareOpen(false)} />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

```
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';

import { Colors, type ThemeColors, type ThemeScheme } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useSettings } from '@/providers/settings-provider';

export interface AppTheme {
  scheme: ThemeScheme;
  isDark: boolean;
  colors: ThemeColors;
}

export function useAppTheme(): AppTheme {
  const systemScheme = useColorScheme();
  const { settings } = useSettings();
  const scheme: ThemeScheme =
    settings.theme === 'system' ? (systemScheme === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark') : settings.theme;
  return {
    scheme,
    isDark: scheme === 'dark',
    colors: Colors[scheme],
  };
}

import { useSettings } from '@/providers/settings-provider';

export interface PerformancePreferences {
  performanceMode: boolean;
  animationsEnabled: boolean;
  autoplay: boolean;
  dataSaver: boolean;
  listProps: {
    removeClippedSubviews: boolean;
    initialNumToRender: number;
    maxToRenderPerBatch: number;
    windowSize: number;
  };
}

export function usePerformance(): PerformancePreferences {
  const { settings } = useSettings();
  const performanceMode = settings.performanceMode;
  const animationsEnabled = !performanceMode && !settings.reducedMotion;
  return {
    performanceMode,
    animationsEnabled,
    autoplay: settings.autoplay && !performanceMode,
    dataSaver: settings.dataSaver || performanceMode,
    listProps: performanceMode
      ? {
          removeClippedSubviews: true,
          initialNumToRender: 2,
          maxToRenderPerBatch: 3,
          windowSize: 3,
        }
      : {
          removeClippedSubviews: false,
          initialNumToRender: 3,
          maxToRenderPerBatch: 5,
          windowSize: 5,
        },
  };
}

import { useFocusEffect } from 'expo-router';
import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { useRepository } from '@/hooks/use-repository';
import type { FeedPost, PostKind } from '@/types/models';

type LoadMode = 'initial' | 'refresh' | 'silent';

export function useFeed(kind: PostKind) {
  const repository = useRepository();
  const [posts, setPosts] = useState<FeedPost[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hasLoaded = useRef(false);
  const pendingLikes = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const pendingReposts = useRef(new Set<string>());

  const load = useCallback(
    async (mode: LoadMode = 'initial') => {
      if (!repository) {
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }
      if (mode === 'initial') {
        setLoading(true);
      } else if (mode === 'refresh') {
        setRefreshing(true);
      }
      try {
        const data = await repository.listPosts(kind);
        setPosts(data);
        setError(null);
      } catch (loadError) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(loadError));
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
        setRefreshing(false);
      }
    },
    [repository, kind],
  );

  useFocusEffect(
    useCallback(() => {
      const mode: LoadMode = hasLoaded.current ? 'silent' : 'initial';
      hasLoaded.current = true;
      load(mode);
    }, [load]),
  );

  const toggleLike = useCallback(
    async (postId: string) => {
      if (!repository || pendingLikes.current.has(postId)) {
        return;
      }
      const target = posts.find((post) => post.id === postId);
      if (!target) {
        return;
      }
      pendingLikes.current.add(postId);
      const nextLiked = !target.likedByMe;
      setPosts((previous) =>
        previous.map((post) =>
          post.id === postId
            ? {
                ...post,
                likedByMe: nextLiked,
                likes: Math.max(0, post.likes + (nextLiked ? 1 : -1)),
              }
            : post,
        ),
      );
      try {
        await repository.toggleLike(postId);
        setError(null);
      } catch (likeError) {
        setPosts((previous) =>
          previous.map((post) =>
            post.id === postId
              ? { ...post, likedByMe: target.likedByMe, likes: target.likes }
              : post,
          ),
        );
        setError(getErrorMessage(likeError));
      } finally {
        pendingLikes.current.delete(postId);
      }
    },
    [posts, repository],
  );

  const toggleRepost = useCallback(
    async (postId: string) => {
      if (!repository || pendingReposts.current.has(postId)) {
        return;
      }
      const target = posts.find((post) => post.id === postId);
      if (!target) {
        return;
      }
      pendingReposts.current.add(postId);
      const nextReposted = !target.repostedByMe;
      setPosts((previous) =>
        previous.map((post) =>
          post.id === postId
            ? {
                ...post,
                repostedByMe: nextReposted,
                reposts: Math.max(0, post.reposts + (nextReposted ? 1 : -1)),
              }
            : post,
        ),
      );
      try {
        await repository.toggleRepost(postId);
        setError(null);
      } catch (repostError) {
        setPosts((previous) =>
          previous.map((post) =>
            post.id === postId
              ? { ...post, repostedByMe: target.repostedByMe, reposts: target.reposts }
              : post,
          ),
        );
        setError(getErrorMessage(repostError));
      } finally {
        pendingReposts.current.delete(postId);
      }
    },
    [posts, repository],
  );

  const refresh = useCallback(() => load('refresh'), [load]);

  return {
    posts,
    loading,
    refreshing,
    error,
    refresh,
    toggleLike,
    toggleRepost,
  };
}
--- src/hooks/use-comments.ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { useRepository } from '@/hooks/use-repository';
import type { Comment } from '@/types/models';

export function useComments(postId: string) {
  const repository = useRepository();
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [loadedPostId, setLoadedPostId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!repository) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const data = await repository.listComments(postId);
      setComments(data);
      setError(null);
    } catch (loadError) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(loadError));
    } finally {
      setLoadedPostId(postId);
    }
  }, [repository, postId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!repository) {
      return;
    }
    repository
      .listComments(postId)
      .then((data) => {
        if (active) {
          setComments(data);
          setError(null);
        }
      })
      .catch((loadError) => {
        if (active) {
          setError(getErrorMessage(loadError));
        }
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (active) {
          setLoadedPostId(postId);
        }
      });
    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [repository, postId]);

  const loading = Boolean(repository) && loadedPostId !== postId;

  const addComment = useCallback(
    async (body: string) => {
      if (!repository) {
        return null;
      }
      setSubmitting(true);
      try {
        const comment = await repository.addComment(postId, body);
        setComments((previous) => [...previous, comment]);
        setError(null);
        return comment;
      } catch (submitError) {
        setError(getErrorMessage(submitError));
        return null;
      } finally {
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    },
    [repository, postId],
  );

  const deleteComment = useCallback(
    async (commentId: string): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!repository) {
        return false;
      }
      const previous = comments;
      setComments((current) => current.filter((comment) => comment.id !== commentId));
      try {
        await repository.deleteComment(commentId);
        return true;
      } catch (deleteError) {
        setComments(previous);
        setError(getErrorMessage(deleteError));
        return false;
      }
    },
    [comments, repository],
  );

  return { comments, loading, submitting, error, addComment, deleteComment, reload: load };
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Alert, Modal, Pressable, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { NetworkBadge } from '@/components/ui/network-badge';
import { getNetwork } from '@/constants/networks';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { openOriginal, shareNative, shareToWhatsApp } from '@/lib/share';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { usePerformance } from '@/hooks/use-performance';
import type { FeedPost } from '@/types/models';

interface ShareSheetProps {
  post: FeedPost | null;
  visible: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export function ShareSheet({ post, visible, onClose }: ShareSheetProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const { animationsEnabled } = usePerformance();
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!post) {
    return null;
  }

  const meta = getNetwork(post.network);

  async function run(id: string, action: () => Promise<void>) {
    setBusy(id);
    try {
      await action();
      onClose();
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível compartilhar', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setBusy(null);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal
      visible={visible}
      transparent
      animationType={animationsEnabled ? 'slide' : 'none'}
      statusBarTranslucent
      onRequestClose={onClose}
    >
      <View style={styles.root}>
        <Pressable
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Fechar compartilhamento"
          style={[styles.backdrop, { backgroundColor: colors.scrim }]}
          onPress={onClose}
        />
        <View
          style={[
            styles.sheet,
            {
              backgroundColor: colors.backgroundElevated,
              borderColor: colors.border,
              paddingBottom: Math.max(insets.bottom, Spacing.lg),
            },
          ]}
        >
          <View style={[styles.handle, { backgroundColor: colors.borderStrong }]} />
          <View style={styles.header}>
            <NetworkBadge network={post.network} />
            <AppText variant="bodyStrong" numberOfLines={1} style={styles.headerTitle}>
              Compartilhar post de {post.author.name}
            </AppText>
          </View>

          <Option
            icon="chatbubbles-outline"
            iconColor="#25D366"
            label="WhatsApp"
            loading={busy === 'whatsapp'}
            onPress={() => run('whatsapp', () => shareToWhatsApp(post))}
          />
          <Option
            icon="share-social-outline"
            label="Mais opções"
            description="Abrir o menu de compartilhamento do sistema"
            loading={busy === 'native'}
            onPress={() => run('native', () => shareNative(post))}
          />
          <Option
            icon={meta.icon}
            iconColor={meta.color}
            label={`Abrir no ${meta.shortName}`}
            description="Ver o post original na rede social"
            loading={busy === 'original'}
            onPress={() => run('original', () => openOriginal(post))}
          />
          <Option icon="close" label="Cancelar" onPress={onClose} />
        </View>
      </View>
    </Modal>
  );
}

interface OptionProps {
  icon: React.ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  iconColor?: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
  onPress: () => void;
}

function Option({ icon, iconColor, label, description, loading, onPress }: OptionProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <Pressable
      accessibilityRole="button"
      accessibilityLabel={label}
      onPress={loading ? undefined : onPress}
      style={({ pressed }) => [styles.option, pressed && { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}
    >
      <View style={[styles.optionIcon, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
        {loading ? (
          <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={colors.primary} />
        ) : (
          <Ionicons name={icon} size={21} color={iconColor ?? colors.text} />
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={styles.optionTexts}>
        <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{label}</AppText>
        {description ? (
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            {description}
          </AppText>
        ) : null}
      </View>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

interface EmptyStateProps {
  icon?: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  title: string;
  description: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon = 'sparkles-outline',
  title,
  description,
  actionLabel,
  onAction,
}: EmptyStateProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <View style={[styles.iconWrap, { backgroundColor: colors.surfaceAlt }]}>
        <Ionicons name={icon} size={30} color={colors.primary} />

      <AppText variant="heading" align="center">
        {title}

      <AppText variant="body" color={colors.textSecondary} align="center" style={styles.description}>
        {description}
      </AppText>
      {actionLabel && onAction ? (
        <Button label={actionLabel} onPress={onAction} variant="secondary" style={styles.action} />
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

```
                      <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{meta.name}</AppText>
                      <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>

                          : 'Conectado via API oficial'}

                    <View style={[styles.statusDot, { backgroundColor: colors.success }]} />

import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';
import Constants from 'expo-constants';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Alert, Pressable, Share, StyleSheet, Switch, View } from 'react-native';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Screen } from '@/components/ui/screen';
import { SettingsGroup, SettingsRow } from '@/components/ui/settings-row';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { getErrorMessage } from '@/lib/errors';
import { useRepository } from '@/hooks/use-repository';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';
import { useSettings } from '@/providers/settings-provider';
import type { ThemePreference } from '@/types/models';

export default function SettingsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { colors, isDark } = useAppTheme();
  const { settings, updateSetting } = useSettings();
  const { profile, connections } = useProfile();
  const { signOut, supabaseEnabled, isDemoMode } = useAuth();
  const repository = useRepository();
  const [exporting, setExporting] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);

  async function handleExport() {
    if (!repository) {
      return;
    }
    setExporting(true);
    try {
      const data = await repository.exportData();
      await Share.share({
        title: 'Meus dados — DopamineMaxxing',
        message: data,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      Alert.alert('Não foi possível exportar', getErrorMessage(error));
    } finally {
      setExporting(false);
    }
  }

  function handleSignOut() {
    Alert.alert('Sair da conta?', 'Você precisará entrar novamente neste dispositivo.', [
      { text: 'Cancelar', style: 'cancel' },
      {
        text: 'Sair',
        style: 'destructive',
        onPress: async () => {
          await signOut();
          router.replace('/(auth)/welcome');
        },
      },
    ]);
  }

  function handleDelete() {
    Alert.alert(
      'Excluir sua conta?',
      'Esta ação é permanente. Seu perfil, conexões, interações e comentários serão removidos. Não é possível desfazer.',
      [
        { text: 'Cancelar', style: 'cancel' },
        {
          text: 'Excluir tudo',
          style: 'destructive',
          onPress: async () => {
            if (!repository) {
              return;
            }
            setDeleting(true);
            try {
              await repository.deleteAccount();
              await signOut();
              router.replace('/(auth)/welcome');
            } catch (error) {
              Alert.alert('Não foi possível excluir', getErrorMessage(error));
            } finally {
              setDeleting(false);
            }
          },
        },
      ],
    );
  }

  return (
    <Screen scroll edges={['top']}>
      <View style={styles.header}>
        <AppText variant="title">Configurações</AppText>
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
          Conta, experiência e privacidade
        </AppText>
      </View>

      <Card
        onPress={() => router.push('/settings/edit-profile')}
        accessibilityLabel="Editar perfil"
        style={styles.profileCard}
      >
        <Avatar name={profile?.displayName ?? 'Você'} uri={profile?.avatarUrl} size={56} />
        <View style={styles.profileTexts}>
          <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{profile?.displayName ?? 'Seu perfil'}</AppText>
          <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
            {profile ? `@${profile.username}` : 'Complete seu perfil'}
          </AppText>
        </View>
        <Ionicons name="chevron-forward" size={18} color={colors.textMuted} />
      </Card>

      <SettingsGroup
        title="Experiência"
        footer="O modo desempenho desativa autoplay, animações e reduz o uso de memória em dispositivos mais antigos."
      >
        <SettingsRow
          icon="speedometer-outline"
          title="Modo desempenho"
          subtitle="Prioriza velocidade e economia de memória"
          right={
            <Switch
              value={settings.performanceMode}
              onValueChange={(value) => updateSetting('performanceMode', value)}
              trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
              thumbColor={settings.performanceMode ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
            />
          }
        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon="play-circle-outline"
          title="Reprodução automática"
          subtitle={settings.performanceMode ? 'Indisponível no modo desempenho' : 'Vídeos tocam ao aparecer'}
          right={
            <Switch
              value={settings.autoplay && !settings.performanceMode}
              disabled={settings.performanceMode}
              onValueChange={(value) => updateSetting('autoplay', value)}
              trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
              thumbColor={settings.autoplay && !settings.performanceMode ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
            />
          }
        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon="cellular-outline"
          title="Economia de dados"
          subtitle="Evita cache de imagens em disco"
          right={
            <Switch
              value={settings.dataSaver}
              onValueChange={(value) => updateSetting('dataSaver', value)}
              trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
              thumbColor={settings.dataSaver ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
            />
          }
        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon="sparkles-outline"
          title="Reduzir animações"
          subtitle="Desativa transições e efeitos de movimento"
          right={
            <Switch
              value={settings.reducedMotion}
              onValueChange={(value) => updateSetting('reducedMotion', value)}
              trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
              thumbColor={settings.reducedMotion ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
            />
          }
        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon={isDark ? 'moon-outline' : 'sunny-outline'}
          title="Tema"
          subtitle="Aparência do aplicativo"
          right={<ThemeSelector value={settings.theme} onChange={(value) => updateSetting('theme', value)} />}
          last
        />
      </SettingsGroup>

      <SettingsGroup title="Conta">
        <SettingsRow
          icon="create-outline"
          title="Editar perfil"
          subtitle="Nome, foto, data de nascimento e localização"
          onPress={() => router.push('/settings/edit-profile')}
        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon="link-outline"
          title="Redes conectadas"
          subtitle={`${connections.length} ${connections.length === 1 ? 'rede conectada' : 'redes conectadas'}`}

        />
        <SettingsRow
          icon="log-out-outline"
          title="Sair"
          subtitle="Encerrar sessão neste dispositivo"
          destructive
          onPress={handleSignOut}
```

```
import { Redirect } from 'expo-router';

import { LoadingView } from '@/components/ui/loading-view';
import { useAuth } from '@/providers/auth-provider';
import { useProfile } from '@/providers/profile-provider';

export default function IndexScreen() {
  const { status } = useAuth();
  const { loading, isOnboarded } = useProfile();

  if (status === 'loading' || loading) {
    return <LoadingView label="Preparando seu feed…" />;
  }

  if (status === 'signedOut') {
    return <Redirect href="/(auth)/welcome" />;
  }

  if (!isOnboarded) {
    return <Redirect href="/(onboarding)/connect" />;
  }

  return <Redirect href="/(tabs)/videos" />;
}
```

```
import { useState, type ComponentProps } from 'react';
import {
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  TextInput,
  View,
  type StyleProp,
  type TextInputProps,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Radius, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';

interface TextFieldProps extends Omit<TextInputProps, 'style'> {
  label?: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  secure?: boolean;
  icon?: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  containerStyle?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
}

export function TextField({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  secure = false,
  icon,
  containerStyle,
  multiline,
  ...rest
}: TextFieldProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const [focused, setFocused] = useState(false);
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState(secure);

  return (
    <View style={[styles.wrapper, containerStyle]}>
      {label ? (
        <AppText variant="label" color={colors.textSecondary} style={styles.label}>
          {label}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.inputWrap,
          {
            backgroundColor: colors.surface,
            borderColor: error ? colors.danger : focused ? colors.primary : colors.border,
            minHeight: multiline ? 112 : 52,
          },
        ]}
      >
        {icon ? <Ionicons name={icon} size={18} color={colors.textMuted} /> : null}
        <TextInput
          {...rest}
          multiline={multiline}
          secureTextEntry={secure ? hidden : false}
          onFocus={(event) => {
            setFocused(true);
            rest.onFocus?.(event);
          }}
          onBlur={(event) => {
            setFocused(false);
            rest.onBlur?.(event);
          }}
          placeholderTextColor={colors.textMuted}
          style={[
            styles.input,
            { color: colors.text, fontFamily: 'Inter_400Regular' },
            multiline ? styles.multiline : null,
          ]}
          accessibilityLabel={label}
        />
        {secure ? (
          <Pressable
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={hidden ? 'Mostrar senha' : 'Ocultar senha'}
            onPress={() => setHidden((current) => !current)}
            hitSlop={10}
          >
            <Ionicons
              name={hidden ? 'eye-outline' : 'eye-off-outline'}
              size={20}
              color={colors.textSecondary}
            />
          </Pressable>
        ) : null}
      </View>
      {error ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.danger} style={styles.helper}>
          {error}
        </AppText>
      ) : hint ? (
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textMuted} style={styles.helper}>
          {hint}
        </AppText>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  wrapper: {
    gap: Spacing.xs,
  },
  label: {
    marginLeft: 0,
  },
  inputWrap: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
```

```
            <Button label="Cancelar" onPress={onCancel} variant="ghost" fullWidth />
          ) : null}
        </>
      )}
    </View>
  );
});

function SwitchRow({
  icon,
  title,
  subtitle,
  value,
  onValueChange,
}: {
  icon: ComponentProps<typeof Ionicons>['name'];
  title: string;
  subtitle: string;
  value: boolean;
  onValueChange: (value: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  return (
    <View style={styles.switchRow}>
      <Ionicons name={icon} size={20} color={colors.textSecondary} />
      <View style={styles.switchTexts}>
        <AppText variant="bodyStrong">{title}</AppText>
        <AppText variant="caption" color={colors.textSecondary}>
          {subtitle}
        </AppText>
      </View>
      <Switch
        value={value}
        onValueChange={onValueChange}
        trackColor={{ false: colors.surfaceAlt, true: colors.primarySoft }}
        thumbColor={value ? colors.primary : colors.textMuted}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

```
import { StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { Ionicons } from '@expo/vector-icons';

import { AppText } from '@/components/ui/app-text';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import { formatRelativeTime } from '@/lib/format';
import { useAppTheme } from '@/hooks/use-app-theme';
import type { FeedPost } from '@/types/models';

interface PostAuthorRowProps {
  post: FeedPost;
  overlay?: boolean;
  avatarSize?: number;
  showAvatar?: boolean;
}

export function PostAuthorRow({
  post,
  overlay = false,
  avatarSize = 40,
  showAvatar = true,
}: PostAuthorRowProps) {
  const { colors } = useAppTheme();
  const textColor = overlay ? '#FFFFFF' : colors.text;
  const secondary = overlay ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.78)' : colors.textSecondary;

  return (
    <View style={styles.row}>
      {showAvatar ? (
        <Avatar
          name={post.author.name}
          uri={post.author.avatarUrl}
          size={avatarSize}
          ringColor={overlay ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : colors.border}
        />
      ) : null}
      <View style={styles.texts}>
        <View style={styles.nameRow}>
          <AppText variant="bodyStrong" color={textColor} numberOfLines={1}>
            {post.author.name}
          </AppText>
          {post.author.verified ? (
            <Ionicons name="checkmark-circle" size={15} color={overlay ? '#7DD3FC' : colors.primary} />
          ) : null}
        </View>
        <AppText variant="caption" color={secondary} numberOfLines={1}>
          @{post.author.handle} · {formatRelativeTime(post.postedAt)}
        </AppText>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: Spacing.sm,
  },
  texts: {
    flex: 1,
    gap: 1,
  },
  nameRow: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: 5,
  },
});

```
